_source: 출처: 공냥이 AI 실험실 «악역영애 말포이» AI 영상 제작 키트(https://malfoy-meme-making.vercel.app/) · 원작자 허락(2026-10-08) · 출처 명기 조건 — 블록 «구조»(고정·가변·꼬리)와 STYLE/BACKGROUND/TAIL 문형은 키트에서 가져옴. CHARACTER/HAIR/OUTFIT 은 IP 소재라 빼고 범용 예시로 새로 씀
_how: image_template.txt 의 {BLOCK} 자리에 넣는다. 빈 블록은 fill 이 건너뛴다. 고정 블록(STYLE·BACKGROUND·TAIL)은 편 전체에서 바꾸지 않는다 — 캐릭터 일관성의 대부분이 여기서 나온다

STYLE.anime_3d: Premium 3D anime game character render, cel-shaded toon shading, crisp rim light, AAA anime action RPG showcase quality.
STYLE.anime_op: Premium 3D anime game character render, cel-shaded toon shading, crisp rim light, composed like a key frame from a TV anime opening sequence.

CHARACTER._rule: 고유명사·작품명 금지. 생김새(나이대·피부·머리색·눈색·표정)로만 묘사. 참조 이미지가 있으면 'Same character as the attached reference:' 로 시작
CHARACTER.with_ref_example: Same character as the attached reference: confident young swordswoman about 18, warm tan skin, short copper-red hair, bright amber eyes, cheeky grin.
CHARACTER.no_ref_example: A confident young swordswoman about 18, warm tan skin, short copper-red hair, bright amber eyes, cheeky grin.

HAIR.example: Hair: short copper-red bob with a single braided strand tied with a small brass ring.

OUTFIT.example: Outfit: cropped navy travel jacket with brass buttons, white shirt, dark utility shorts, knee-high brown boots, fingerless gloves.
OUTFIT.second_ref_lock: She wears the exact outfit from the second reference image, unchanged in design and colors.

POSE.example: Full body, standing three-quarter view, one hand on the sword hilt, chin slightly raised.

BACKGROUND.blue_chroma: Background: perfectly flat solid pure blue (#1E3CFF) studio backdrop, evenly lit, no gradient, no floor line, no shadows on the backdrop, the whole character clearly separated from the background with clean edges, for chroma keying.
BACKGROUND._rule: 합성용 컷은 반드시 blue_chroma. 인월드(배경 포함) 컷만 장면 묘사로 바꾼다

TAIL.no_text: No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.
